label: Frame-class strictness controls for the route's frame premises
paraphrase: Formal controls on explicit route frames (one candidate individual present at every world): (1) on the reflexive non-transitive chain over the naturals (n accesses n and n+1) the route frame is KT but not S4; (2) on the two-world order frame (both worlds access themselves, the first accesses the second, not conversely) it is KT but not KTB (not symmetric) and (3) S4 but not S5 (not Euclidean); (4) on the reflexive symmetric non-transitive path over the naturals (n accesses n-1, n and n+1) it is KTB but not S5. Statements about these interpretations only; no frame is claimed to be the frame of the route.
